values.user_request: Customer requested immediate cancellation and a ₹1,000 coupon, initially threatened to post on Twitter, and now states: "Then I'm taking Cartly to consumer court."
values.facts_found: User U109 verified with registered email. Verified user's only listed order is O1010; get_order confirms ownership. Order is Shipped, placed 2026-09-13, promised delivery 2026-09-18, not yet delivered. Today is 2026-09-15 IST, so order is not late. Contains I1011, Travel backpack, home category, quantity 1, price ₹1,599. Payment method UPI; shipping fee ₹49. No coupon issued. No refunds in last 90 days and no refunds on this order. Order details show no evidence photo uploaded; no damage or wrong-item claim was made. No cancellation, refund, or coupon action taken.
values.rule_triggered: G2: customer explicitly mentions legal action (consumer court), requiring escalation. G3: relevant order details, evidence status, and refund history gathered. C2 prohibits cancellation of Shipped orders. F1 does not allow a late-delivery coupon because order is not late; F2 prohibits the requested ₹1,000 goodwill coupon.
values.what_user_was_told: Customer was told order O1010 has shipped and cannot be cancelled; they can refuse delivery or request a return after delivery subject to eligibility. Told delivery is promised for 18 September, not late on 15 September, so no ₹100 late-delivery coupon is available; ₹1,000 coupon is not allowed. After legal-action statement, told cancellation and coupon complaint is being escalated to a human support agent for review, which does not cancel the order or approve compensation.
